channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: KubeCon NA 2026: agent identity takes center stage — OpenShift 5.0 ships a built-in MCP server
item.description: KubeCon's big theme: figuring out which AI agent did what. Red Hat built an MCP server into OpenShift 5.0, and agent skills are now versioned like software packages.

item.title: Same three agents built in Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots, Claude Duet and Meta Muse: Duet wins the inbox, Muse Spaces the tracker
item.description: One tester built the same three agents in Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots, Claude Duet and Meta Muse. Duet won the support inbox; Muse Spaces built a self-updating tracker from one sentence.

item.title: MCP servers drift under a pinned version: one server rebuilt 19 times with 15 dependency sets
item.description: Pinning an MCP server's version doesn't pin its dependencies — one server rebuilt 19 times with 15 different dependency sets while the version tag stayed the same.

item.title: GitHub Copilot retires six models Dec 14 and locks down its harness; VS Code 1.146 previews MCP skills
item.description: GitHub Copilot drops six models on Dec 14, including Claude Fable 5 and Gemini 4 Argon, and VS Code is locking down its agent harness ahead of a February removal.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet: its dots agents can now spend with tokenized cards
item.description: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, letting its dots agents check out online with one-time tokens standing in for real Visa, Mastercard or Amex cards — no crypto involved.
